captions.detailed: A utility blimp featuring a thick, aerodynamic grey envelope, a compact dark blue gondola suspended underneath, and twin engine pods mounted on lateral vectoring pylons. The tail section has a cruciform configuration consisting of grey horizontal and vertical fins with movable control surfaces. The engine pods are equipped with four-bladed propellers that spin continuously, and the pods themselves can tilt on their lateral pylons.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a utility blimp with a thick grey envelope, a dark blue gondola suspended by thin structural cables, twin lateral engine pods with four-bladed propellers, and a cruciform tail assembly. Define revolute articulations for the rudder on the vertical stabilizer, the elevators on the horizontal stabilizers, and the engine pods on their pylons, as well as continuous rotation for the propellers.
captions.factory: The code constructs the main envelope by lofting or revolving a streamlined profile. It models the gondola using a box combined with a cylinder and attaches it via thin cylinder struts. The tail fins and control surfaces (rudder and elevators) are built from box primitives, positioned at the rear of the envelope, and connected via revolute joints. The lateral pylons, engine pods, and propellers are constructed using cylinders and boxes, with revolute joints defined for pod tilting and continuous joints for propeller rotation.
